detail.longDescription: Finally got around to setting up my first new # kubernetes node, it's a second-hand HP elitedesk 800 g4 and it surprised me by not matching the sellers description It surprisingly includes 2 M.2 SSDs: one 256 GB and one 1TB, and a 256GB sata SSD. And apparently 32GB of RAM I got this and 3 other computers shipped for ~€100, this is looking like a real bargain!
